about: Every figure the generator is calibrated to, dated, with the id of its entry in the register of sources. The register is a document of the working repository, and docs/SOURCES.md lists its cited entries in the public copy. In the working repository scripts/qa-gen.ts checks the data against this file. A figure marked assumption has no published source; the method says so where it is used.

calendar.why: Period 1 of every data set starts on Monday 6 July 2026, the first full week under the rules in force from 30 June 2026 (SI 2026/621: the GBP 800 crypto information line, the GBP 10,000 cash line, enhanced due diligence for FATF call-for-action countries). Period n starts (n - 1) x days later.

travelRule.source: S45 MLR 64C(4) and 64G(1)(b), substituted by SI 2026/621 reg 32

cashLine.source: S46 MLR reg 14(1)(a), high value dealers

fasterPayments.source: S06 Pay.UK transaction limits page, read 13 Nov 2026. The scheme allows one payment of up to GBP 1m. 7 of the listed organisations show a personal online limit of GBP 25,000 for one payment, and business online limits run from GBP 10,000 to GBP 1m

chaps.source: S08 Bank of England, CHAPS: open 6am, customer payments by 5.40pm

bacs.source: S09 Bacs three-day cycle; entry on the third working day, early morning

cash.source: S13 Nationwide daily limits: GBP 500 at a machine

contactless.source: S15 most firms kept GBP 100 after 19 Mar 2026

app2024.source: S01 UK Finance Annual Fraud Report 2025 (data for 2024). Each figure below is a ratio that this project computed from the report's totals for the scam type. This file holds no figure of the report
app2024.note: Computed from the totals for all cases in 2024 (personal and non-personal together). Each ratio is kept at full precision, so that a seed number gives the same data set as it gave before 13 November 2026.

card2024.source: S01 UK Finance Annual Fraud Report 2025 (data for 2024). Each figure below is the mean value of a case, which this project computed from the report's totals for the type of card fraud

remoteBanking2024.source: S01 UK Finance Annual Fraud Report 2025 (data for 2024). The figure is the mean value of a case of unauthorised remote banking fraud, which this project computed from the report's totals

railMix2025.source: S11 UK Finance, press release on its Payment Markets Report 2025. The ordinary rail mix of the generator follows the release in 4 points, which are cards for most spending, cash for under a tenth of payments, Faster Payments for transfers and Direct Debit for bills. This file holds no figure of the release

mcc.source: S16 Visa Merchant Data Standards Manual, April 2026 (codes); the weights are an assumption

lumpSums.source: S54 ONS, Intergenerational transfers: the distribution of inheritances, gifts and loans, Great Britain: 2014 to 2016 (30 Oct 2018), Wealth and Assets Survey
lumpSums.spreadAnchor: no published spread; a lognormal around the published median

assumptions.note: Rates with no published source, stated so the method can say where it assumes. Each is used for ordinary customers so a rule that reads the signal raises false alerts as it would in a bank.

sessionChannelRetail.anchor: S11: most adults use mobile banking

copOrdinaryNewPayee.anchor: S07 describes the four outcomes; no published split was found

threeDSOutsideUkEea.anchor: S42: card fraud 17 times higher outside the EEA, where authentication may not be required

assumptions.householdSharedDeviceAnchor: no published rate; family members banking on one phone or tablet is the ordinary noise a shared-device rule lives with
assumptions.launderingRoundAnchor: no published share; S32's library holds a scenario for transactions in round amounts, so some laundering moves round sums
assumptions.genuineSecurityEventsAnchor: no published rates; S25 names SIM swaps, changed details and alerts switched off as the takeover trail, and genuine customers make the same changes
assumptions.cryptoBuyByTransferAnchor: no published split; S52 shows a UK bank recognises payments to UK crypto exchanges and limits them, so genuine customers do pay exchanges by bank transfer
